text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track progress easily. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points during the project that show you are moving in the right direction. Deliverables, the final products or results, should be agreed on from the start. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters because everyone involved needs to share the same understanding of what the project will achieve. When these elements are in place, projects run more smoothly and teams work together better.
